# Pavel Samuta / Павел Самута

> Independent mechanical engineer and industrial technical partner in Minsk, Belarus. Engineering practice since 2007. Industrial mechanical equipment, physical parts and production documentation. Works with enterprises in Belarus and other CIS countries.

## Professional boundaries
Scope concerns mechanical engineering and industrial equipment, not architectural, structural-building or independent electrical design. Technical deliverables, fees and dates depend on project inputs and a mutually agreed scope. Published project results are examples, not performance guarantees.
